title: Weighted complete-cube orbits have an l2-controlled fourth-defect floor

weighted_floor.profile: Use known deterministic phases |c_(N,k)|=1 and positive weights rho_(N,k) on the complete cube, with R_N=sum sqrt(rho_(N,k))c_(N,k)e^(ikx) and A_N^2=eta/N.
weighted_floor.moments: Uniform translation and global phase give E M_N(x)^2=(eta/N)sum rho_k and E M_N(x)^4=(3eta^2/(2N^2))int|R_N|^4.
weighted_floor.l2_conversion: Cauchy gives (sum rho_k)^2<=d_N sum rho_k^2 and hence gD_(M,N)>=-3g eta^2(d_N/N^2)sum rho_k^2.
weighted_floor.scope_guard: The floor is not an equality or flatness claim and does not control an arbitrary non-orbit law.
